newsitem.title: USA: Fulton to buy Keystone in shr swap.
newsitem.headline: Fulton to buy Keystone in shr swap.

text.p: Fulton Financial Corp said Friday it signed a definitive agreement to buy Keystone Heritage Group Inc in an stock exchange.
Fulton said it will give Keystone shareholders 1.83 Fulton shares for each share they hold in the tax-free merger on a pooling of interest basis.
Fulton said the deal values Keystone at $52.84 a share, based on Fulton's closing bid stock price of $28.875 a share August 14.
Fulton also said it received an option to buy 19.9 percent of Keystone's stock at the current market value as part of the deal.
The deal is valued at about $210 million, as Keystone has about 4.0 million shares outstanding.
The bank holding company said the $52.84 a share price for Keystone equates to 20.8 times trailing 12-month earnings and a multiple of 3.2 times Keystone's book value as of June 3O, l997.
Fulton said the acquisition is subject to approval by bank regulatory authorities and Keystone shareholders. It added it expected to close the deal during the first quarter of 1998.

Keystone is a bank holding company with $640 million in assets. Its sole subsidiary, Lebanon Valley National Bank, operates 24 community banking offices in Lebanon, Lancaster, Dauphin, Berks and Schuylkill counties in Pennsylvania.
Keystone reported a net income of $5.4 million, or $1.37 per share, in the first half of 1997, compared with a $4.0 million net, or $0.98 a share the year before.
"This acquisition solidifies our market position, and gives us an opportunity to achieve substantial operating efficiencies and enhanced revenue growth," a Fulton statement said.

Fulton said it would have more than $5 billion in assets after the merger. The holding company currently operates 117 offices in Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware and New Jersey through 10 affiliate banks.
Trading in Keystone's stock was halted Friday morning on the American Stock Exchange with the last sale at 37-1/2. It resumed at 47 in the afternoon and traded at 48-3/4 later, up 12.
Fulton's stock dropped 5/8 to 28-1/4 Friday afternoon.
